Waraq / العودة إلى ورق

What Waraq can do

Tools, offline use and editing limits. Reviewed 9 October 2026.

On your device

Arrange and combine PDFs, extract pages, resize sheets, make booklets, compare page images, annotate, sign visually, fill AcroForms, redact marked regions into image-only PDFs, create templates and recognize Arabic/English text. These tools use the libraries bundled with this installation.

Exports retain the original filename and Waraq branding, for example contract-waraq-annotated.pdf. A merged document uses the first source name unless you change it.

بالعربية

رتب الملفات وادمجها واستخرج الصفحات وغيّر حجمها وأنشئ كتيبات وقارن الصفحات وأضف التعليقات والتوقيع المرئي واملأ النماذج واستخرج النص العربي والإنجليزي. تحافظ أسماء النتائج على اسم الملف الأصلي مع علامة ورق ونوع العملية.

How OCR works

PDF.js renders the pages. Tesseract runs in a local WebAssembly worker using bundled Arabic and English language models. Choose either language or both, process up to 20 pages, review the recognized text and download it as TXT. No account or external OCR service is needed for this tool.

A searchable PDF is a separate operation: the optional OCRmyPDF engine preserves page images and adds a text layer. It requires a configured processing engine. OCR can misread letters, columns and numbers; review the result.

بالعربية

تُحوّل الصفحات إلى صور ثم يتعرف محرك Tesseract المحلي على النص باستخدام نماذج عربية وإنجليزية مرفقة. راجع النص ونزّله بصيغة TXT. إنشاء PDF قابل للبحث عملية منفصلة تحتاج إلى محرك OCRmyPDF. قد يخطئ التعرف على الحروف والأعمدة والأرقام.

Offline and self-hosted

Use the main app's offline download panel. The complete website ZIP includes local PDF libraries and OCR models. With Node.js 22+ already installed, run START-WARAQ.cmd on Windows or node server.cjs on another system.

You can also serve the ZIP's dist folder through an HTTP/HTTPS static server, including under a subdirectory. Opening its HTML using file:// is unsupported. Native conversion engines require separate dependencies; downloading the web app does not install them.

“Save app in this browser” prepares the application and OCR models for offline use at the same address. Browser storage may be cleared; keep the ZIP for a durable copy.

بالعربية

تتضمن حزمة الموقع المكتبات ونماذج OCR. شغّلها بخادم Node.js محلي أو انشر مجلد dist على استضافة ملفات ثابتة. لا يعمل فتح HTML مباشرة عبر file://. أدوات تحويل أوفيس والمحركات الأصلية تحتاج اعتماديات منفصلة. احتفظ بحزمة ZIP لأن المتصفح قد يمسح ذاكرته المؤقتة.

Full PDF editing: current limits

CapabilityStatus
Page organization and added text/marksAvailable locally
AcroForm fillingAvailable; output is flattened
Visual signatureAvailable; not a certificate signature
Remove marked regionsAvailable through raster redaction; output loses searchable text
Edit existing text with font preservation and reflowNot implemented
Replace arbitrary existing images/objectsNot implemented
Certified digital signing, XFA and accessibility remediationNot implemented
Office conversion, encryption, searchable PDFRequire a compatible connected engine

Waraq is not yet a complete Acrobat replacement. PDF4QT and ONLYOFFICE PDF Editor are candidates for deeper editing integration. They are not bundled here.

بالعربية

ورق ليس بديلاً كاملاً لأكروبات بعد. تعديل النص الأصلي مع الحفاظ على الخط وإعادة تدفق الفقرات واستبدال العناصر والتوقيع الرقمي المعتمد لا تزال غير منفذة. إضافة نص فوق الصفحة تختلف عن تعديل النص الأصلي.

Comparison and sources

We reviewed Acrobat online, iLovePDF and opdf.io as product references. Opdf describes browser-local tools, but an official source repository and license were not verified, so it is not presented as an open-source integration. The offline kit contains the detailed capability audit and open-source research.

Stirling, qpdf, LibreOffice and OCRmyPDF connections are optional. Their tools appear ready only when the companion reports support. A remote engine receives your file after the explicitly labeled processing action.
